svg.desc: 1057 commits across five public projects, 73 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-29 through 2026-10-20 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-20T04:40:38.889Z.
